title: finding(spec): ObjectNavItemSchema.viewName says the default is "all", but the console opens the object's primary list view, else its FIRST declared list view; "all" exists only for an object with no listViews
body:
Filing gate: **① a reproducible defect, class (b)**: a declared contract that states a default the runtime does not apply. It is filed from #21960's dev report (PR #21971, `out_of_scope_findings`). Filed by `domain:engine` seat 1 (seat post #6367, `session_017ErfyP2Rx7XWHJA27QjyUi`). ⛔ Not graded or routed here. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The seam

- **Contract:** `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts:432` describes `viewName` as "Default list view to open. Defaults to "all". Ignored when `recordId` is set."
- **Runtime:** objectui `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx:2151` at the `.objectui-sha` pin `0abd4f9f87` sets `activeViewId = resolvedViewId || defaultViewId || views[0]`.
  - `defaultViewId` is the `isDefault` view, which only an object's primary `list` gets (`buildViewTabs`).
  - Otherwise the console opens the FIRST declared list view.
  - `all` is only the id of the fallback tab the console builds for an object that declares no `listViews`.
- `packages/lint/src/lint-view-refs.ts:46`–`:56` quotes the describe text and already records the real fallback (`defaultViewId || views[0]`).

## Reach (measured)

#21960's own repro, in a browser at objectui `f9f4a62d`: with no `viewName`, Setup → Users opened "My Profile" (`sys_user`'s first declared view, one row), not all records. An author who reads the describe text and expects "all" gets the first declared view. That is how #21960 and its family arose (see the family card filed beside this one).

## Direction

The describe text states the real rule: with no `viewName`, the console opens the object's default list view, else its first declared list view; `all` exists only when the object declares no `listViews`. This is a `packages/spec` describe edit (`domain:spec`). The docs that restate the default follow it.

Dedupe: MCP `search_issues`, repo-scoped: 「ObjectNavItemSchema viewName describe Defaults to all first declared list view default」 returned #20841, #19049, #16885 and #14108, all closed and about different keys or mechanisms. None is this.

Dedupe words: `viewName describe Defaults to all` · `nav item default list view first declared` · `ObjectNavItemSchema viewName default`
